tools.name: microsoft_docs_search
tools.description: Search official Microsoft/Azure documentation. Returns up to 10 content chunks (title, URL, excerpt) from Microsoft Learn and other official sources.

query.description: A query or topic about Microsoft/Azure products, services, platforms, developer tools, frameworks, or APIs

tools.name: microsoft_docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a Microsoft Learn documentation page and convert it to markdown, including headings, code blocks, tables and links.

url.description: URL of the Microsoft documentation page to read

tools.name: microsoft_code_sample_search
tools.description: Search official Microsoft Learn code samples for Microsoft/Azure SDKs, APIs and services. Returns the latest official snippets.

query.description: A descriptive query, SDK name, method name or code snippet

language.description: Optional language filter: csharp, javascript, typescript, python, powershell, azurecli, al, sql, java, kusto, cpp, go, rust, ruby, php
